dialog.english:
��������Sorry to keep you waiting, Lord
Vamdemon.
dialog.translation:
Disculpad la espera, Señor
Myotismon.

dialog.english:
This is a good spot to make our
base.
dialog.translation:
Buen sitio para nuestra
base.

dialog.english:
Now we just have to deal with the
eighth Chosen Child. Find them as
soon as possible.
dialog.translation:
Ahora solo queda ocuparse del
octavo Niño Elegido. Encontradlo
cuanto antes.

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
dialog.translation: Sí señor!

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
dialog.translation: Sí señor!

dialog.english:
Morning! Seems like there was an
awful commotion around here.
dialog.translation:
Buenos días! Parece que hubo un
jaleo tremendo por aquí.

dialog.english:
They've been talking about it
nonstop on the morning news.
dialog.translation:
No paran de hablar de eso en
las noticias de la mañana.

dialog.english:
So the only one we're still
waiting for would be...
dialog.translation:
Así que el único que falta
por llegar sería...

dialog.english: Just Joe.
dialog.translation: Solo Joe.

dialog.english: What's he up to, anyway?
dialog.translation: Qué estará tramando?

dialog.english: Let's wait until he gets here.
dialog.translation: Esperemos a que llegue.

dialog.english:
It's been a while since I've been
able to play soccer. I pulled off
some nice dribbles.
dialog.translation:
Hacía tiempo que no jugaba al
fútbol. Hice unos regates
muy buenos.

dialog.english:
Even though you haven't been near
a ball in so long?
dialog.translation:
Aunque no hayas tocado un
balón en tanto tiempo?

dialog.english:
Yeah! All that training in the
Digital World must have made me a
better athlete.
dialog.translation:
Sí! Todo el entrenamiento en el
Mundo Digimon debe haberme
hecho mejor atleta.

dialog.english:
Did you improve at soccer too,
Sora?
dialog.translation:
Mejoraste en fútbol
también, Sora?

dialog.english:
I dunno. I haven't been able to
get to a ball lately, so I really
have no idea.
dialog.translation:
No sé. Últimamente no he
podido jugar, así que no
tengo ni idea.

dialog.english: I wanna play soccer, too!
dialog.translation: Yo también quiero jugar!

dialog.english:
Okay, then let's have a match
someday!
dialog.translation:
Vale, echamos un partido
algún día!

dialog.english: Yeah, sounds fun!
dialog.translation: Sí, qué guay!

dialog.english: Soccer really is fun.
dialog.translation: El fútbol mola mucho.

dialog.english:
It's a nice day out today. On a
day like this, I want to go out
for a drive and play some music...
dialog.translation:
Hace un día precioso. Días así,
me apetece salir a dar una
vuelta y poner música...

dialog.english: Is your dad busy with his job?
dialog.translation: Tu padre está liado?

dialog.english: Would you take some lunch, too?
dialog.translation:
Le llevas comida
también?

dialog.english:
Yeah, he comes home and then goes
right back.
dialog.translation:
Sí, viene a casa y luego
se va otra vez.

dialog.english:
But I guess that's not really a
bad thing...
dialog.translation:
Pero supongo que eso no
está tan mal...

dialog.english: Haha!
dialog.translation: Jaja!

dialog.english:
Mattooooo, I wanna ride in a car
too!
dialog.translation:
Mattooooo, quiero ir
en coche también!

dialog.english:
Well, if we have time, we'll take
you driving.
dialog.translation:
Si hay tiempo, te llevamos
a dar una vuelta.

dialog.english: Yay!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english: B-U-T! Only if you're Tsunomon!
dialog.translation:
P-E-R-O! Solo si eres
Tsunomon!

dialog.english:
We'd get into a pretty awkward
situation if I made lunch.
dialog.translation:
Sería bastante incómodo si
tuviera que hacer la comida.

dialog.english:
The busier he gets, the more my
dad pressures me about it...
dialog.translation:
Cuanto más ocupado está, más
me presiona mi padre con eso...

dialog.english:
S-sorry. That wasn't very cool of
me, saying something like that...
dialog.translation:
L-lo siento. No fue muy guay
de mi parte decir eso...

dialog.english:
My dad's going to be up all night
tonight, too...
dialog.translation:
Mi padre tampoco va a dormir
esta noche...

dialog.english:
Ever since we got home, I've been
busy performing maintenance on my
computer.
dialog.translation:
Desde que volvimos, he estado
ocupado dando mantenimiento a
mi ordenador.

dialog.english: Is it that important to you?
dialog.translation: Tan importante es para ti?

dialog.english:
I couldn't repair anything in the
Digimon world, after all...let
alone find replacement parts.
dialog.translation:
No pude reparar nada en el
Mundo Digimon, y mucho menos
encontrar piezas de recambio.

dialog.english:
We're all the way here in the
human world, but I've been stuck
in his room the whole time...
dialog.translation:
Aquí estamos en el mundo
humano, pero he pasado todo
el rato metido en su cuarto...

dialog.english: Sorry, Tentomon.
dialog.translation: Perdón, Tentomon

dialog.english:
You really like computers, don't
you, Izzy?
dialog.translation:
Te encantan los ordenadores,
verdad, Izzy?

dialog.english:
Yes. Would you consider that
strange?
dialog.translation: Sí. Te parece raro?

dialog.english: It's not strange at all!
dialog.translation: No es nada raro!

dialog.english: It might be a bit unusual...
dialog.translation: Quizá sea un poco inusual...

dialog.english:
I-is that so? That makes me kind
of happy.
dialog.translation:
E-en serio? Eso me hace
un poco feliz.

dialog.english:
Your computer was a really huge
help back when we were in the
Digimon world.
dialog.translation:
Tu ordenador nos ayudó
muchísimo cuando estábamos en
el Mundo Digimon.

dialog.english:
It's a privilege to be of
assistance.
dialog.translation:
Es un privilegio poder
ayudar.

dialog.english: I thought so...
dialog.translation: Lo suponía...

dialog.english:
Don't worry about it. It's good
for people to be a little unique.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes. Está bien
ser un poco especial.

dialog.english: Ahaha...
dialog.translation: Jaja...

dialog.english:
I should buy a new computer soon.
Hmm...
dialog.translation:
Debería comprar
ordenador nuevo. Hmm...

dialog.english:
There really is no place like
home! I have food here and a nice,
cool room!
dialog.translation:
No hay lugar como el hogar!
Tengo comida y una habitación
fresquita!

dialog.english:
And when you open the fridge,
there's cola!
dialog.translation:
Y cuando abres la nevera,
hay cola!

dialog.english:
Mimi, you haven't even left the
house once since we got back.
dialog.translation:
Mimi, no has salido de casa
ni una vez desde que volvimos.

dialog.english:
You're tired from all that walking
in the Digimon world, aren't you?
dialog.translation:
Estarás cansada de tanto
caminar en el Mundo Digimon,
no?

dialog.english:
I'm staying home this summer
vacation! I won't take a single
step out the door!
dialog.translation:
Me quedo en casa estas
vacaciones de verano! No
pienso salir por la puerta!

dialog.english: Aren't you gonna get fat?
dialog.translation: No vas a engordar?

dialog.english: Not even if you were going overseas?
dialog.translation:
Ni aunque fueras al
extranjero?

dialog.english: You're right.
dialog.translation: Tienes razón.

dialog.english:
You have to exercise, at least a
little. How about soccer?
dialog.translation:
Tienes que hacer algo de
ejercicio. Qué tal el fútbol?

dialog.english:
Ehhhhhhhhhhh, I'd prefer a more
casual sport.
dialog.translation:
Ehhhhhh, prefiero un deporte
más relajado.

dialog.english:
Okay, then maybe I'd leave! If we
were going to Hawaii or something.
dialog.translation:
Vale, quizá sí saldría! Si
fuéramos a Hawái o algo así.

dialog.english:
Hawaii's by the ocean, so you'll
have the chance to move around.
dialog.translation:
Hawái está junto al mar, así
que podrás moverte bien.

dialog.english:
Nah, I wanna drink juice and lie
on the beach...
dialog.translation:
Nah, quiero beber zumo y
tumbarme en la playa...

dialog.english:
Ahaha, but that's not very
different from what you'd do at
home.
dialog.translation:
Jajaja, pero eso no es muy
distinto de lo que harías
en casa.

dialog.english:
But it's a good idea! I'll ask
Papa.
dialog.translation:
Buena idea! Se lo
preguntaré a papá.

dialog.english:
I'm spending my summer vacation
relaxing! This really is the best.
dialog.translation:
Paso mis vacaciones de verano
relajándome! Esto es lo mejor.

dialog.english:
Sora! I'm gonna spend my vacation
playing at my grandma's house!
dialog.translation:
Sora! Voy a pasar mis vacaciones
jugando en casa de mi abuela!

dialog.english: Oh, wow! Where does she live?
dialog.translation: Vaya! Dónde vive?

dialog.english: She lives in Shimane.
dialog.translation: Vive en Shimane.

dialog.english: Is Patamon coming with you?
dialog.translation: Patamon irá contigo?

dialog.english: Where's Shimane?
dialog.translation: Dónde queda eso?

dialog.english: Yeah! T.K's taking me with him.
dialog.translation: Sí! T.K. me lleva con él.

dialog.english:
It'll be your first time in an
airplane, right?
dialog.translation:
Será tu primera vez en avión,
no?

dialog.english:
Of course! Being in a flying
vehicle sounds fun.
dialog.translation:
Claro! Ir en algo que vuela
suena divertido.

dialog.english: Haha, sounds fun.
dialog.translation: Jaja, qué guay.

dialog.english:
It'll be lots of fun! I'm sure
you'll be surprised, Patamon!
dialog.translation:
Va a ser muy divertido!
Seguro que te sorprende, Patamon!

dialog.english: That's horrible, Sora!
dialog.translation: Qué horror, Sora!

dialog.english:
I *should* know, but it looks like
it's slipped my mind.
dialog.translation:
Se supone que lo sé, pero
se me fue de la cabeza.

dialog.english: Really?
dialog.translation: Ah sí?

dialog.english: Really. Shimane... Shimane?
dialog.translation: Sí. Shimane... Shimane?

dialog.english: Hmph!
dialog.translation: Hmph!

dialog.english: I wonder if Grandma's doing okay.
dialog.translation:
Espero que la abuela esté
bien.

dialog.english: Heeeeeeeeeeeey!
dialog.translation: Eeeeeeeeeeey!

dialog.english: Joe!
dialog.translation: Joe!

dialog.english:
Sorry. I had a bit of a hard time
finding my old class roster.
dialog.translation:
Perdón. Me costó un poco
encontrar mi vieja lista
de clase.

dialog.english: Someone's clearly taking it easy.
dialog.translation:
Alguien se relaja
bastante.

dialog.english:
The eighth child witnessed the
Digimon incident in Karigaoka
four years ago, just like we did.
dialog.translation:
El octavo niño vivió el incidente
Digimon en Hikarioka hace
cuatro años, igual que nosotros

dialog.english:
And furthermore, we should note
that they were in this area last
night.
dialog.translation:
Y además, hay que tener en
cuenta que estuvo por esta zona
anoche.

dialog.english:
Izzy found a signal last
night.
dialog.translation:
Izzy detectó una señal
anoche.

dialog.english:
For that reason, I believe that
today we should split up and try
searching this area.
dialog.translation:
Por eso, creo que hoy
deberíamos separarnos e
intentar buscar en esta zona.

dialog.english: Got it!
dialog.translation: Vale!

dialog.english:
That sounds good... even though
it's burning hot out here.
dialog.translation:
Suena bien... aunque hace
un calor abrasador aquí.

dialog.english:
So what should I do with the
roster I found?
dialog.translation:
Y qué hago con la lista
que encontré?

dialog.english:
There's a high possibility that
the eighth child's name is in
there.
dialog.translation:
Hay muchas posibilidades de que
el nombre del octavo niño
esté ahí.

dialog.english:
Please call each of them and ask
them if they were in Shibaura last
night.
dialog.translation:
Llama a cada uno y pregúntales
si estuvieron en Shibaura
anoche.

dialog.english:
I have summer classes starting
tomorrow. I'll take care of the
phone calls as soon as possible...
dialog.translation:
Mañana empiezo las clases de
verano. Me encargaré de las
llamadas en cuanto pueda...

dialog.english:
But let me stay home, instead of
going out to look for them.
dialog.translation:
Pero dejadme quedarme en casa,
en vez de salir a buscarlos.

dialog.english: That's not fair, Joe!
dialog.translation: Eso no es justo, Joe!

dialog.english:
I-I can't help it! I've got
entrance exams!
dialog.translation:
N-no lo evito! Tengo
exámenes de acceso!

dialog.english:
Okay, then I'll give you my share
as well. Here's the directory for
Wakaba Kindergarten.
dialog.translation:
Vale, pues te doy mi parte
también. Aquí está el directorio
de la Guardería Wakaba.

dialog.english:
Good idea! Here's the roster for
Fourth Elementary. Do a good job!
dialog.translation:
Buena idea! Aquí está la lista
del Colegio Cuarto. Buen trabajo!

dialog.english:
It may be better to leave this all
to one person.
dialog.translation:
Igual es mejor dejárselo
todo a una sola persona.

dialog.english:
Sounds like a plan. I'll leave
this to you, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Me parece bien. Te lo dejo
a ti, Joe.

dialog.english: Hey, hey...Tai, not you too?
dialog.translation:
Oye, oye...Tai, tú
también?

dialog.english:
Don't worry! I'm not gonna make
other people do my work.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo! No voy a hacer
que otros hagan mi trabajo.

dialog.english: You're such a nice guy!
dialog.translation: Qué tío tan majo!

dialog.english:
I bet he actually just couldn't
find his directory.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que en realidad no
encontró su directorio.

dialog.english:
Okay! Let's split up and find the
eighth child!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Separémonos y busquemos
al octavo niño!

dialog.english: Good luck, everyone.
dialog.translation: Suerte a todos.

dialog.english: Ugh... Okay then, good luck, guys.
dialog.translation: Ugh... Vale, suerte, chicos.

dialog.english: Let's look together, T.K.
dialog.translation: Busquemos juntos, T.K.

dialog.english: Okay! I'll go with you, Matt!
dialog.translation: Vale! Voy contigo, Matt!

dialog.english:
Mimi, let's go search for the
eighth child together.
dialog.translation:
Mimi, busquemos juntas al
octavo niño.

dialog.english: Okaaaaaaay!
dialog.translation: Valeeeee!

dialog.english: Where are you going, Tailmon?
dialog.translation: Dónde vas, Gatomon?

dialog.english:
To search for the eighth child.
That's our mission, right?
dialog.translation:
A buscar al octavo niño.
Esa es nuestra misión, no?

dialog.english:
Trying to take all the credit,
huh? You're always like that.
dialog.translation:
Intentando llevarte todo el
mérito? Siempre igual.

dialog.english: What?!
dialog.translation: Qué?!

dialog.english:
I'm the one who found the clue to 
the eighth child! So I get to 
search this place! It's only fair!
dialog.translation:
Fui yo quien encontró la pista
del octavo niño! Así que
me toca buscar aquí! Es justo!

dialog.english:
You think the eighth child is
always going to stay in one place?
dialog.translation:
Crees que el octavo niño
siempre está en el mismo
sitio?

dialog.english:
If you think they've moved, then
go look somewhere else! Hahahaha!
dialog.translation:
Si crees que se ha movido, ve
a buscar a otro sitio!
Jajajaja!

dialog.english:
Hmph! You're just a little bat
who's always trying to kiss up to
Vamdemon!
dialog.translation:
Já! No eres más que un
murcielaguito que siempre
babea por Myotismon!

dialog.english:
(Even when I was still in my Child
form, Plotmon, Vamdemon always
worked me to the bone.)
dialog.translation:
(Incluso con Novato,
Salamon, Myotismon me hacía
trabajar sin parar.)

dialog.english:
(And if anything went wrong, he
would beat me up...)
dialog.translation:
(Y si algo salía mal, me
pegaba...)

dialog.english:
(Because he doesn't like my
eyes... I was born with them, I
can't help it...)
dialog.translation:
(Porque no le gustan mis
ojos... nací con ellos así,
no puedo evitarlo...)

dialog.english:
(Born... I don't even remember
where I was born...)
dialog.translation:
(Nací... ni recuerdo
dónde nací...)

dialog.english:
(or what I was doing before I met
Vamdemon...)
dialog.translation:
(o qué hacía antes de
conocer a Myotismon...)

dialog.english: Tailmon...
dialog.translation: Gatomon...

dialog.english: Ah!
dialog.translation: Ah!

dialog.english: Reminiscing on old times?
dialog.translation: Recordando el pasado?

dialog.english: Wizarmon...
dialog.translation: Wizardmon..

dialog.english:
Didn't I tell you not to read my
mind without my permission?
dialog.translation:
No te dije que no leyeras mi
mente sin permiso?

dialog.english: I apologize, I didn't mean to.
dialog.translation: Perdón, no quería.

dialog.english:
I'm going to go look for the
eighth child...
dialog.translation:
Voy a buscar al octavo
niño...

dialog.english:
How are we supposed to look for
the eighth child?
dialog.translation:
Cómo se supone que busquemos
al octavo niño?

dialog.english:
For now, we should ask people if
they've ever lived in Karigaoka.
dialog.translation:
Por ahora, preguntemos a la
gente si vivió en Hikarioka.

dialog.english: That sounds like a lot of work.
dialog.translation: Suena a mucho trabajo.

dialog.english: ~30 minutes later~
dialog.translation: ~30 min. después~

dialog.english:
Ah! There's a fast food joint over
there! Sora, why don't we rest up
for a bit?
dialog.translation:
Ah! Hay un sitio de comida
rápida ahí! Sora, por qué no
descansamos un poco?

dialog.english:
We have to take this seriously,
Mimi.
dialog.translation:
Vamos en serio con esto,
Mimi.

dialog.english: Hmph...
dialog.translation: Hmph...

dialog.english: ~After another 30 minutes~
dialog.translation: ~Otros 30 minutos después~

dialog.english:
Why do I have to do this? We just
got home, and yet...
dialog.translation:
Por qué esto? Si acabamos
de llegar, y encima...

dialog.english: Sora, let's take a short break.
dialog.translation: Sora, descansemos un poco.

dialog.english: Can't be helped, I guess.
dialog.translation: No hay más remedio.

dialog.english:
Last night I was in a room with a
fluffy bed and air conditioning!
dialog.translation:
Anoche dormí en cama mullida
y con aire acondicionado!

dialog.english:
It's really great, being at
home...
dialog.translation: Se está genial en casa...

dialog.english: And the food was delicious...
dialog.translation: Y la comida, riquísima...

dialog.english:
Yeah, yeah! It was the first time
I ever thought Mama's cooking was
so delicious.
dialog.translation:
Sí, sí! Fue la primera vez que
pensé que la comida de mamá
estaba tan rica.

dialog.english:
The food at Sora's house was
delicious, too. Sora's mom seems
like a very nice person.
dialog.translation:
La comida en casa de Sora
también estaba deliciosa. Su
madre parece muy buena persona.

dialog.english:
You think so? Thanks... Anyway,
back to work, back to work...
dialog.translation:
Ah sí? Gracias... Bueno,
a trabajar, a trabajar...

dialog.english:
Sora, why don't we go someplace
where lots of people gather?
dialog.translation:
Sora, por qué no vamos a
algún sitio con mucha gente?

dialog.english: Where lots of people gather?
dialog.translation: Con mucha gente?

dialog.english:
Mmmmm! It's so nice and cool! I
love being in places with air
conditioning!
dialog.translation:
Mmmmm! Qué gustito hace!
Me encanta el aire
acondicionado!

dialog.english:
I *thought* you'd have an ulterior
motive...
dialog.translation:
Sabía que tenías
segundas intenciones...

dialog.english:
Woooow! This place is really
crowded.
dialog.translation:
Guaaau! Este sitio está
a tope.

dialog.english:
That's because it's a tourist
attraction, you know.
dialog.translation:
Es que es una atracción
turística, ya sabes.

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora, your house is over
here, right?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Sora, tu casa está
por aquí, no?

dialog.english:
Yeah. This is the world we live
in.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Este es el mundo en
que vivimos

dialog.english: Mimi, isn't it a bit hot?
dialog.translation: Mimi, no hace calor?

dialog.english:
Yeah. Maybe the air conditioning
doesn't work as well around here?
dialog.translation:
Sí. Quizá el aire
acondicionado no funcione
tan bien por aquí?

dialog.english: Is the air conditioner broken?
dialog.translation: El aire está roto?

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Gyaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Gyaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: It's a Digimon!
dialog.translation: Es un Digimon!

dialog.english: RAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
dialog.translation: RAAAAAAAAARGH!

dialog.english: Sora!
dialog.translation: Sora!

dialog.english:
The only thing we can do is fight
him, Mimi!
dialog.translation:
Solo podemos luchar contra
él, Mimi!

dialog.english: We did it!
dialog.translation: Ya está!

dialog.english:
Whew. We managed to make it out of
that one... somehow.
dialog.translation:
Uf. Al final conseguimos
salir de esta... de algún modo

dialog.english:
But to think he'd appear in a
tourist attraction, with so many
people around.
dialog.translation:
Y pensar que apareció en una
zona turística, con tanta
gente alrededor.

dialog.english:
Let's hurry. We have to find the
eighth child.
dialog.translation:
Rápido, hay que
encontrar al octavo niño.

dialog.english: They're a peaceful lot...
dialog.translation: Qué gente tan pacífica...

dialog.english:
Miko! Where are you, Miko? Where
are you...?
dialog.translation:
Miko! Dónde estás, Miko?
Dónde estás...?

dialog.english: Are you Agumon's friend?
dialog.translation: Eres amiga de Agumon?

dialog.english: Ah, wait!
dialog.translation: Espera!

dialog.english:
How did she know about Agumon?
Could she be the eighth child?
dialog.translation:
Cómo sabe lo de Agumon?
Será el octavo niño?

dialog.english:
(I really don't think she's a
normal kid. Best to just get rid
of her now.)
dialog.translation:
(No creo que sea una niña
normal. Mejor deshacerse de
ella ahora mismo.)

dialog.english: It's you again!
dialog.translation: Otra vez tú!

dialog.english: C'mere...
dialog.translation: Ven...

dialog.english: Are you gonna come back again?
dialog.translation: Vas a volver otra vez?

dialog.english:
There isn't enough evidence that
she's the eighth child.
dialog.translation:
No hay pruebas suficientes de
que sea el octavo niño.

dialog.english:
But why? That child... why do I
get this feeling?
dialog.translation:
Pero por qué? Esa niña...
por qué siento esto?

dialog.english: I wonder if Joe's coming after all.
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si Joe vendrá
al final.

dialog.english: We should wait for him together.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos esperarlo
juntos.
